summary: F0 passed 64 focused tests. A subsequent audit repaired generation-only concern propagation and all 12 issue-search tests passed again. Trigger generation requests are about 17.5 KB each, well below the 200 KB limit. Execute the separately bounded repair of the output meaning and eight source trigger claims.
findings: The post-F0 repair makes generation concerns and deferred hypotheses trigger reconsideration even if critics omit them. It is recorded in post-f0-concern-repair.xml; it consumes no model calls.
Two readers receive full source and fixed factual vocabulary without peer outputs. The program computes trigger satisfaction and must retain upstream judgment and carve-out assumptions.

All eight original claims tied to the Q3 trigger are checked against every new candidate in four-pair requests. The baseline 204-pair matrix remains unchanged and is not a before/after accuracy benchmark.
At most eight trigger candidates, 512 Java/Python evaluations, 54 calls including retries and a cumulative ceiling of 113 are admitted for F1.
Unknown and conflicting facts retain typed outcomes. No agreement, compilation result or fidelity label establishes English correctness or institutional release approval.
